name: mdx-threat-model

threats.description: Consequential action runs without PDP decision.
Receipt is written outside StorageProvider or Ledger chain semantics.
Tenant data crosses RLS or typed tenant boundaries.
Provider marked live before observed evidence.
Twin companion drifts from grounded advice into ungoverned tool execution.
Ephemeral worker exceeds scope, budget, tool allowlist, or retirement bounds.
Legacy app runtime creates a parallel source of truth.
Live credential leaks through status, generated artifact, nested generated artifact, receipt payload, or logs.
Credential-looking payload, private key material, symlink, or nested non-JSON payload lands under generated security artifacts.

rules: every threat maps to a mitigation check
high impact threats map to generated evidence
new live substrate app runtime or worker behavior updates this model
